getEthValue(uint256).details: For stETH: 1 stETH ≈ 1 ETH (rebasing). The LST balance IS the ETH backing      net of slashings. Returning the LST amount as ETH equivalent is correct      for stETH-denominated holdings.

lastUpdated().details: This oracle reads the live stETH contract on every call, so the price is      always as fresh as the latest on-chain oracle/rebase update reflected on-chain.      Returning `block.timestamp` makes any reasonable staleness check pass while      still letting consumers wire the same guard they would use against a      push-style oracle. If a future implementation caches values, replace this      with the timestamp of the cached read.

getEthValue(uint256).notice: ETH value (wei) of `lstAmount` LST tokens at current price.

getLstValue(uint256).notice: Inverse: how many LST tokens correspond to `ethAmount` wei.

lastUpdated().notice: Unix timestamp of the most recent price update the oracle relied on.
